draft.emotion: straightforward and respectful, speaking of someone clearly
notes: Used on its own for men in general, and preceded by 'người' to refer to individual men ('một người đàn ông', a man).
Refers to adult men, unlike 'con trai' (boy; son); the female counterpart is 'đàn bà' or the more polite 'phụ nữ' (woman).
